violations.description: Preventing contamination of packaged and unpackaged food. — --Different species of raw animal food was not properly separated from each other or arranged according to minimum cooking temperatures. -Tubes of raw hamburger stored on wire shelf above vacuum sealed packages of whole muscle beef in walk in cooler.--Raw animal food was not properly separated from raw or cooked ready-to-eat food. -Placed saran wrapped cheese on counter top without sanitizing after handling hamburger patties at same location.

Contaminated food disposition. — --Room temperature tomatoes are cut before and after lunch and again before and after supper, with left over placed into refrigeration at end of night. *Ensure to timestamp room temperature foods for Disposal every 4 hours OR keep at 41F or less during service.

Temperature measuring devices. — --Temperature measuring device was not provided. -Did not locate thermometer in small refrigerator, condiment/tea refrigerator or in upright side by side refrigerator. *Thermometer should be available in all refrigeration units to facilitate monitoring.

Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Food contact surface used with potentially hazardous food was not cleaned every four hours while in use or as frequently as required. -Bowl used with fried foods stated as washed daily.--Nonfood contact surface was not cleaned as frequently as required. -Frost build up at freezer compartment of undercounter refrigerator at shake station.

Preventing contamination of packaged and unpackaged food. — --Equipment/utensil was not properly cleaned and sanitized between uses to prevent cross-contamination. -Unopened bags of shredded lettuce stored directly next to bin of open raw beef. *Corrected on-site, moved lettuce to different shelf. -Raw whole shell flats of eggs stored on 2nd from top wire shelf in walk in cooler.

Preventing contamination from equipment, utensils, and wiping cloths. — --Cloth for wiping food spills was not stored in sanitizing solution (at proper concentration) between uses. -Sani bucket at ice cream station found at less than 150ppm Quat solution. *COS-refilled bucket.
Toilet facilities. — --Toilet room was not provided with a tight fitting or self closing door. -Both restroom doors were open during inspection. *COS - attached spring/closed.

Date marking and disposition of ready-to-eat potentially hazardous food. — --Refrigerated, ready-to-eat potentially hazardous food (prepared more than 24 hours ago) was not properly date marked. -No date marking in refrigerators at cookline. (i.e. chopped ham, portioned crab meat, sliced tomatoes, etc.) -Macaroni salad in walk in cooler is not date marked.

Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Nonfood contact surface was not cleaned as frequently as required. -Residue at refrigerator handles. -Some residue at utensil drawer handle. -Dust/debris buildup on fan near ice machine.
Single-service and single-use articles. — --Single-service item was not stored in a proper location to be protected from contamination. Ice bags are stored below a fly strip in dry storage area.
Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc. …) were not maintained in good repair. -Water damaged ceiling in walk in cooler.
Clean, maintained, tissue, vented, self-closing door (1 pt deducted)
Design, construction, clean, maintained (1 pt deducted)
Clean, employee dressing area, cleaning equipment storage, living/sleeping quarters separate (1 pt deducted)
Date marking accomplished, discarded (2 pts deducted)
Designed, constructed, installed, and maintained (1 pt deducted)
Cleaning frequency, maintained clean (1 pt deducted)
